entries.prompt: Edit this HD-2D background game sprite: ONE single fairly flat floating island with a small rustic European village across the top. Preserve the attractive hand-crafted square-pixel style and approximate architectural design of the CENTRAL main island, but make the whole single island a muted violet/lavender DISTANT silhouette with limited subdued colors, lower contrast and minimal detail. Remove EVERY detached fragment, every separate miniature island, every piece of floating rubble, every speck and all pale/white/blue background objects. Keep only the central island including village, connected cliff underside and roots that attach to the main body. No clouds or background scenery. Use a TRUE TRANSPARENT background alpha zero everywhere beyond ONE CONNECTED island silhouette. No gray matte, no white/black background, no halo, no outline fragments. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, stepped shading, zero blur or antialiasing into transparent background. Center the full island with modest transparent margins on a 2:1 horizontal canvas intended for 768x384 pixels; preserve every village roof and cliff tip inside the canvas. No words, labels, people, UI, signature. Native larger size acceptable. Only the single isolated island.
entries.correction_reason: remove detached alpha fragments; respect muted violet distant island subject

technical_cleanup.operation: alpha threshold at 128; retain largest connected alpha component; clear RGB outside silhouette

entries.description: enduit crème (#EAE0CB) un peu sali, colombages de bois brun
entries.prompt: Replace this wall material with a corrected game-ready HD-2D SEAMLESS plaster material. Remove all the regular brown diagonal crosses, square wooden grid and repeating frame beams. The requested material is the creamy plaster infill of rustic European half-timbered houses; the wood framing is already supplied in the building facades separately. Therefore this swatch should show ONLY aged cream plaster (#EAE0CB), slightly uneven and gently worn, muted warm beige and soft gray-beige flecks, extremely sparse tiny hairline cracks, broad very gentle subtle variations with no obvious motif. OPAQUE FULL-BLEED texture, front elevation without perspective, no visible border, no raised plaster wall object, no cast shadows, no lighting gradient. Seamlessly tile on all FOUR edges; opposite edges match with unobtrusive irregular grain. Soft fine square pixel clusters and modest stepped shading, no smooth photoreal painting, no blur, no diagonal wooden crosses, no grid, no dominant patches, no regularly spaced dots, no stones or brickwork. Intended exact square 192x192px at 96px/metre, native larger allowed but suitable for nearest-neighbor reduction. No labels, letters, numbers, watermark or signature.
